page.overview:
Who is Risi Amps?

Risi Amps was a male Labbo wreck dealer who was a member of a group of rebels led by the Devaronian Blue. He lived on the planet Rumitaka, purchased a ship from Jyn Erso, which he noticed was full of fake codes. Years later, Amps hired Erso to create fake ident codes and ship docs for his rebel team. Some time later, he and Erso were arrested by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn.
